overview: MoneyDrive is an earnings optimization and income expansion system for South African ride-hailing drivers. It combines AI-powered income tools, in-car sales, advertising deal pipelines, and community features to help drivers maximize their earnings and build wealth.
features: Community Forum (eTavern) with anonymous/profiled posting, voice notes, threaded replies, and likes
AI agent Nduna with persistent memory and autonomous marketing
In-car sales with SnapScan QR payments
Advertising deal pipeline and pitch deck generator
Driver Wealth Academy with MiniPay savings
Opportunity Hunter with Browserbase cloud browsing
